modules.wording: Defined scope and guardrails for Winter Walk's internal Google Workspace operating system, including explicit limits on CRM functionality, public dashboards, automated sending, and causal fundraising claims.
Implemented fail-closed email controls that block live follow-up when the kill switch, test mode, or live-followup restriction is active, before queue-level eligibility checks run.
Built a Google Drive-to-Workbook A CSV import workflow with automated logging for successful, held, and failed runs.
Built a self-report evidence workflow that maps form responses into the Evidence Log and syncs approved updates to the Adoption Matrix with audit logging.
Documented 10 passing pilot/UAT checks covering import validation, PII absence, applicability checks, and related functional scenarios.
Mapped Winter Walk's manual OP-support workflow into a structured operating process covering evidence tracking, review, follow-up, and human approval.
Built a Python/Streamlit prototype for preliminary coffee-shop market screening using documented heuristic scoring boundaries.
Separated deterministic scoring from an optional LLM narrative layer instructed not to alter scores, thresholds, status, or scenario calculations.
Integrated Google Places nearby-search and U.S. Census ACS demographic data into a coffee-shop market-screening workflow.
Implemented a 3.5-mile geofence, a local 50-request daily limit, and retry with degraded stub fallback for failed Places or Census fetches.
Built an automated pytest suite covering the MarketMind screening pipeline.
Reviewed 500+ user cases weekly against platform policy, identifying violations and behavioral patterns across structured and unstructured data under time-sensitive conditions.
